Fuzzes SBPF program loading with a fixed syscall set.

# Purpose
This file defines a libFuzzer entry point for the `fd_sbpf_loader` code. It initializes the Firedancer runtime in [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>), disables backtrace output, sets the log level so warnings stop the run, and registers `fd_halt` for process exit. The file also defines a fixed list of syscall identifiers in `_syscalls`, which it inserts into an `fd_sbpf_syscalls_t` object before each load attempt.

[`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) treats each input buffer as a candidate SBPF ELF program. It first calls `fd_sbpf_elf_peek` to read ELF metadata and reject inputs that do not match the loader limits in `fd_sbpf_loader_config_t`. If the input passes this check, the code allocates the objects needed for loading: a program object with `fd_sbpf_program_new`, a syscall table with `fd_sbpf_syscalls_new`, a read-only data buffer, and a scratch buffer. It then calls `fd_sbpf_program_load` to test the loader against the fuzz input, and frees all allocated resources before returning. This file is a fuzz test harness for the SBPF program loader and its ELF parsing path.
